name: Sandro Gozi - § 10
title: REPORT on the institutional consequences of the EU enlargement negotiations
part_text: Notes that the current composition of the Commission must take enlargement into account; recalls, in this regard, the flexibility provided for in the Treaty of Lisbon; highlights that any reduction in the size of the College of Commissioners, as prescribed in Article 17(5) TEU, must continue to ensure a geographically, demographically and gender-balanced composition of the Commission;
